summary: Fetch-and-eval of unpinned unpkg URL on CLI startup and library import
details: src/use-m-bootstrap.lib.mjs sets USE_M_BOOTSTRAP_URL to https://unpkg.com/use-m/use.js — an unpinned, mutable 'latest' URL — fetches the response body, and executes it via await eval(...). This bootstrap runs at the top level of src/config.lib.mjs and is transitively pulled in by the hive, solve, task, fix, and telegram-bot bin entry points, and by any consumer that imports the package as a library. The use-m package is not declared in package.json dependencies, so the code executed on every run is whatever the current 'latest' unpkg redirect resolves to at fetch time — controlled by the use-m publisher rather than by the installer's package.json or lockfile. Approximately 40 source files further extend this pattern by calling globalThis.use('<pkg>') (command-stream, path, getenv, and others) provided by the eval'd bootstrap, so the concrete versions of many runtime dependencies are chosen by the remote use-m code and are not visible to npm's dependency resolution or lockfile pinning.
